source_snapshot.items: Upgrade / Downgrade GPU firmware without AC restart
source_snapshot.procedure: In BMC WebUI GPU Management > Firmware, add a file and update GPU firmware; no AC cycle after flash completion.
source_snapshot.criteria: Flash succeeds without AC restart and GPU firmware version is verified.
source_snapshot.script: No Master command; 10 attended/15 machine minutes; unique row/code/variant.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; uses user-provided image, BMC upload, before/after inventory and interruption warning but lacks exact direction/activation/rollback contract.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION/CRITICAL; requires immutable GPU/image compatibility, separate direction matrix, stable power, one-shot job evidence, active-versus-staged proof and recovery.

old_problem: The historical review left an approved flash workflow pending for exact GPU/image, separate upgrade/downgrade directions and non-AC activation. Those can be signed per-transaction gates while retaining the mandatory firmware write and before/after evidence.
disposition_reason: The source expressly authorizes firmware programming through BMC and prohibits an AC restart afterward. ED-03/07/11/12/15/18/20/30 permit exact GPU, signed images, direction order, documented non-AC activation and health oracle as execution parameters, but ED-07/12 require Flash to remain and each transaction to receive independent one-shot authorization with before/after active-version proof. Upgrade and downgrade are not collapsed; each is separately evidenced and failure is never automatically reflashed.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2221, same-row DeepSeek columns, GPT V2, historical record, unique identity and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2222 / Wistron-BMC Sanity-00005-V001 / 433ac289d56786f1 was directly read from XLSX and its historical record.
Bind exact SUT/BMC and GPU UUID/serial/slot/BDF/board PN/firmware component; never select identical devices by index alone.
Define two independent directions: approved version A→B Upgrade and B→A Downgrade, with separate signed image filename/version/hash/signature/compatibility and separate authorization/evidence.
Drain all GPU work and maintain stable BMC/network/power; record upload validation, exact target, all job phases/progress and terminal result without refresh/navigation/interruption.
Use only vendor-documented activation that does not remove AC—live, GPU reset, driver reload or host reboot as explicitly approved—and distinguish active from staged version.
Power telemetry must prove no AC loss for each transaction; after activation verify same GPU active version, enumeration, driver/diagnostics and XID/AER/BMC health.
Stop on mismatch, wrong target, job stall/failure, unexpected AC event or loss/fault; no blind reflash, opposite-direction retry or automatic recovery.
No WebUI login/upload, image validation, flash, activation, reset/reload/reboot, AC action, query, rollback, retry or DUT action was executed.

test_case.test_name: Separate one-shot GPU firmware upgrade and downgrade through BMC without AC restart
test_case.purpose: Demonstrate independently that approved GPU firmware upgrade and downgrade images can each be programmed and activated on the exact GPU through BMC without AC restart, with correct active version and healthy device/platform state.
required_package: SUT/BMC firmware and GPU UUID/serial/slot/BDF/board/component identity
Separate Upgrade A→B and Downgrade B→A image filename/version/hash/signature/compatibility records
BMC job phases, timeouts, terminal criteria and active-versus-staged semantics
Vendor-approved non-AC activation per direction plus no-AC power telemetry oracle
Workload drain, stable power/network, independent authorization per flash, rollback tool/image and recovery/RMA
test_case.test_command: For each direction as a separate transaction, first collect exact GPU active/staged version, identity, workload, health and power baseline; validate that direction's signed image and obtain its independent one-shot Flash authorization. Through BMC GPU Management upload once to the verified UUID/serial, record validation/target/job phases/progress to terminal state without interruption, perform only the signed non-AC activation, prove no AC loss from telemetry, then verify active version and full GPU/driver/diagnostic/XID/AER/BMC health. Do not start the other direction until this transaction has an engineer disposition.
test_case.expected_result: For each separately authorized Upgrade and Downgrade transaction, the exact GPU accepts the compatible signed image, BMC job completes, the target version becomes active through the approved non-AC mechanism, no AC loss occurs, device/platform health passes, and rollback/recovery remains available.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS is direction-specific and requires immutable target/image identity, complete terminal job, approved non-AC activation, before/after active-version change, no-AC proof and health. Wrong target/image, validation/job failure, staged-only result, unexpected AC, version mismatch, GPU/BMC loss, XID/AER/thermal fault or failed recovery is FAIL for that direction. One direction cannot PASS the other; missing image/activation/recovery blocks execution, not review.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED separately for Upgrade and Downgrade until exact target/image/direction, compatibility/signature/hash, activation, stable power/network, rollback and one-shot authorization are signed.
Drain GPU processes/schedulers and verify same UUID/serial/board component before every upload.
Never refresh, navigate away, reset, interrupt or AC-cycle an active job; no ambiguous image, index-only target or undocumented activation.
Stop on validation mismatch, wrong target, stall/failure, unexpected AC, GPU/BMC loss or XID/AER/thermal fault; no automatic reflash or opposite-direction retry.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash and immutable GPU UUID/serial/slot/BDF/board/component identity
Separate direction matrix and signed Upgrade/Downgrade image filename/version/hash/signature/compatibility
Independent authorization and complete BMC target/upload/validation/job phase/terminal evidence per direction
Before/staged/after active version plus approved non-AC activation and power telemetry proving no AC loss
test_case.recovery: On validation, target, job, activation, version or health failure, do not reflash or run the opposite direction automatically. Preserve job and power evidence, keep stable power and management access, and have the vendor/GPU owner follow the signed recovery or rollback only after explicit authorization; escalate unrecoverable devices to the RMA path.

source_conflict.reason: The unique source consistently requires GPU firmware change and no AC restart; direction, image and activation details are runtime project configuration.

blocked.reason: The BMC flash purpose and safety envelope are clear; signed images, separate direction matrix and non-AC activation are execution prerequisites.
